target_buyers.fit_rationale: Administers SNAP, Medicaid, cash assistance, child care, and adult protective services. Eligibility screening tools would streamline intake and reduce caseworker workload.
target_buyers.outreach_strategy: Contact Executive Director Patrick Arcaro directly about piloting eligibility screening integration. Eligibility Pro's multi-program calculator would directly address their mission to streamline benefits access.

target_buyers.fit_rationale: Provides services to alleviate poverty. Benefits eligibility screening would complement their existing programs and help clients access additional resources.
target_buyers.outreach_strategy: Approach Executive Director Alissa Holdson with focus on how eligibility screening integrates with their anti-poverty mission. IT Director Dino Mauri is key technical contact. Health & Nutrition Director Ilana Litwak would be end-user champion.

research_notes.acdjfs: Primary county agency for benefits administration. Patrick Arcaro has been Executive Director since 2004 - very stable leadership. No direct email published but follows standard jfs.ohio.gov pattern. Multiple verified department emails available.
research_notes.accaa: Comprehensive staff directory available online. Executive Director Alissa Holdson and IT Director Dino Mauri are primary targets. Well-established organization (founded 1965) with 51-200 employees. Strong web presence and modern contact info.
